TokenRules.description:
The single-player token (`hello.token`): the embedded server only talks to the client that
started it.

length.description:
Hex characters in the token. The client makes one of exactly this length; the server
refuses to start with any other.

deltas_per_second.description: Deltas sent per real second, at most. Each delta carries every tick since the last.

max_catch_up_seconds.description:
If the server falls more than this many real seconds behind its speed (a stall), it
drops the backlog instead of racing to catch up.

max_walkers.description: Walker positions sent per message, at most.

recent_bids.description: Bid events kept for the snapshot's recent history.

start_speed.description: The speed step a new game starts at (`0` = paused).

ticks_per_second.description:
Ticks per real second for speed steps 1, 2, 3 and 4, in that order. Each step must be
faster than the one before.
